bear_assumptions: USD 0.35 normalized per-share cash earnings at 19x plus USD 2.35 surplus financial value; ARR growth slows, retention weakens, competition raises spending and dilution persists.
base_assumptions: USD 0.60 normalized per-share cash earnings at 24x plus USD 2.60 surplus financial value; ARR grows near low double digits, margins improve and buybacks broadly offset dilution.
bull_assumptions: USD 0.80 normalized per-share cash earnings at 30x plus USD 3.00 surplus financial value; orchestration sustains stronger growth and retention while stock compensation declines as a share of revenue.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade the operative disposition only if fresh results sustain ARR growth, retention, GAAP profitability and per-share cash earnings while price and scenario asymmetry clear every economic and relationship gate; downgrade if growth, retention, margins, guidance, leadership execution, competition, agentic adoption, capital allocation, stock compensation, dilution, cybersecurity or AI-governance evidence deteriorates.
